answer: Reviewers stake on their grades and a 10 percent sample is re-graded; a reviewer who stops working loses the seat after 6 epochs. Example: an identity grades 40 answers, then idles, and its violet badge expires before the next close, so the 40 grades it issued stand but earn nothing further. That is the trellis: seats grow only with fresh work. A farm can buy the stake but not the saffron of continuous review, and 40 idle seats cost 40 stakes with no return.
